weight_statistics_scope: Complete selected Linear matrix; all input and output channels
output_statistics_scope: All saved token rows of primary BF16 paired inputs and full output width
output_error_definition: Bias-free FP32 matrix products: X_basis @ (W_quantized - W_reference).T, normalized by squared norm of X_basis @ W_reference.T. Rebuild each X_basis in FP32 from the same saved BF16 paired_raw input and frozen transform. No A4.
native_boundary: SpinQuant packed INT4 decoded offline; VQ banks decoded to their effective BF16 weights. This analysis does not execute native kernels or measure speed.
